principle_violations.reason: UnitUpgrader is checking the type of the apartment using getClass() to determine behavior, which is a violation of LSP. This means derived classes are not substitutable for base classes without altering behavior.
principle_violations.suggestion: Incorporate the ability to determine numberOfBedrooms upgrade into the Apartment hierarchy, allowing each derived class to dictate how many bedrooms they should gain during an upgrade.
